topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution and outlines the session's core learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution, Mutational Selection, and Epigenetic Plasticity
topics.groupedBecause: They show how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive advantages that drive Darwinian clonal selection in tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how normal stem cell hierarchies and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and evaluate evidence for cancer stem cells across different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Stromal Dependency, and Integrated Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how microenvironmental cues and inflammatory signals drive tumor outgrowth, how these cellular interactions are experimentally investigated, and how they integrate into a multi-factorial evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and indicates the topic of the upcoming lecture.
